summary: Minimal, correct fix: guards leaf nodes (TREE_UNDEFINED = -2) against negative indexing into feature_names, which broke when a single feature made feature_names[-2] out of range. Uses the same _tree.TREE_UNDEFINED constant already used in export_text's recursion, so leaf entries (never consumed as split names) safely become None.

issues.description: The else branch (feature_names is None) still builds 'feature_{-2}' strings for leaf nodes; harmless since leaf entries are never read as split names, but left slightly inconsistent with the new guard.
